description: Play a completion sound when Claude finishes a turn.

hooks.command: node -e "const os=require('os'),cp=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs');if(process.env.CLAUDE_HOOK_SOUND==='off')process.exit(0);const custom=process.env.CLAUDE_HOOK_SOUND_STOP;const p=os.platform();function isWSL(){try{return /microsoft/i.test(fs.readFileSync('/proc/version','utf8'))}catch(e){return false}}function bell(){process.stdout.write('\u0007')}function tryRun(cmds,i){if(i>=cmds.length){bell();return}const c=cmds[i];try{const ch=cp.spawn(c[0],c[1],{stdio:'ignore',detached:true});ch.on('error',()=>tryRun(cmds,i+1));ch.unref()}catch(e){tryRun(cmds,i+1)}}let cmds;if(p==='darwin')cmds=[['afplay',[custom||'/System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff']]];else if(p==='win32')cmds=custom?[['powershell',['-NoProfile','-c','(New-Object Media.SoundPlayer $env:CLAUDE_HOOK_SOUND_STOP).PlaySync()']]]:[['powershell',['-NoProfile','-c','[System.Media.SystemSounds]::Asterisk.Play()']]];else if(isWSL())cmds=custom?[['paplay',[custom]],['aplay',[custom]],['powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-c','[System.Media.SystemSounds]::Asterisk.Play()']]]:[['powershell.exe',['-NoProfile','-c','[System.Media.SystemSounds]::Asterisk.Play()']],['paplay',['/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga']],['aplay',['/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga']]];else cmds=[['paplay',[custom||'/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga']],['aplay',[custom||'/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga']]];tryRun(cmds,0)"
